title: Another tanker carrying Russian diesel changes course en route to U.S. – Bloomberg
summary: A tanker carrying Russian diesel fuel, which briefly listed the United States as its destination, changed course about 400 nautical miles from New York, adding to uncertainty over Russian fuel supplies to the North American market.

title: Ukrainian Red Cross vehicle damaged in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia
summary: A vehicle belonging to the Ukrainian Red Cross Society was damaged in a Russian attack in Zaporizhzhia on Monday.

title: SSU detains Dnipro resident suspected of directing Russian strikes
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) counterintelligence has exposed a local woman in Dnipro suspected of directing Russian strikes on fuel and energy infrastructure facilities and logistics centers on orders from Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB).

title: Russian agent posing as SSU officer sentenced to 15 years for directing strikes on Ochakiv
summary: A Russian agent who impersonated an SSU officer and directed Russian strikes on Ochakiv, Mykolaiv region, has been sentenced to 15 years in prison.

title: Second day of trilateral talks begins in Abu Dhabi
summary: The second day of talks between Ukraine, the United States and Russia on ending the war began in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday.

title: Russian strikes hit energy infrastructure in southern Odesa region
summary: Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure in the southern part of the Odesa region in the evening of November 10 and early on November 11; a woman was killed.

title: Russian strikes in Kharkiv region injure woman, damage infrastructure
summary: Russian forces attacked Kharkiv and 11 other settlements in the Kharkiv region over past day, damaging infrastructure and injuring a woman.

title: Russian attack damages private house in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district
summary: A private house in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district was damaged in a Russian attack.

title: Two Russian Banderol missiles enter Moldovan airspace during attack on Ukraine
summary: Two Russian Banderol-type cruise missiles violated Moldova’s airspace in the morning of Wednesday, November 11, amid Russia’s massive attacks on Ukraine.

title: Russian nighttime attack on Chernihiv sparks fire at private enterprise, damages vehicles
summary: Russian forces attacked Chernihiv overnight on November 11, sparking a fire at a private enterprise.

title: War update: 125 clashes on front line over past day, Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors remain hottest
summary: Over the past day, November 10, a total of 125 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line, with the heaviest enemy attacks reported in the Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk sectors.

title: Drones attack Russia's strategic Ust-Luga port, sparking fire
summary: On the night of Wednesday, November 11, drones struck Ust-Luga, Russia's second-largest port, located near the city of St. Petersburg.

title: Russian army loses another 2,580 personnel, two air defense systems in war against Ukraine
summary: Russia's total estimated combat losses since the beginning of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, through November 11, 2026, have reached approximately 1,614,180 personnel, including 2,580 over the past 24 hours.

title: Air Defense neutralizes 14 Banderol missiles, 130 Russian drones overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 14 Banderol missiles and 130 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 10.

title: Kharkiv hit by two consecutive missile strikes
summary: Kharkiv was hit by two consecutive missile strikes targeting the city's Industrialnyi and Saltivskyi districts.

title: Zelensky discusses support for Ukraine with Northern European Prime Ministers amid Russian escalation
summary: The President discussed the diplomatic process and support for Ukraine with the prime ministers of Northern European countries against the backdrop of Russia's escalating attacks.

title: Kryvyi Rih under massive Russian drone attack: Parts of city without electricity and heating
summary: Kryvyi Rih has come under a massive attack by Russian unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), leaving parts of the city without electricity and heating. Residential buildings, schools, and kindergartens have been damaged.

title: Zelensky on front line situation assessments: Putin lives in different reality
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that during today's trilateral negotiations, Russian representatives claimed that Russia had occupied parts of the Donbas that are actually under Ukrainian control. According to him, this demonstrates significant differences in how the battlefield situation is being assessed.

title: Europe must appoint representative for peace negotiations by end of November – Zelensky
summary: Europe must decide by the end of November who will represent it in negotiations aimed at ending the war in Ukraine. Ideally, this decision should be made at a meeting in Germany on November 19.

title: Zelensky presents Northern European partners with plan for getting through winter
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky presented Northern European countries with Ukraine’s winter preparedness plan, which includes additional supplies of diesel fuel and improved protection for bridges.

title: Poland says Pentagon green lit for permanent U.S. military base
summary: Poland has received the Pentagon’s "green light" to establish a permanent U.S. military base on its territory.

title: Russia cannot destroy Kyiv HPP with airstrikes, expert says
summary: The Kyiv Hydroelectric Power Plant (HPP) is a highly robust structure that could not realistically be destroyed even by ten Russian missiles, according to an expert.
